meta.title: daslang compiler tools for tryengine
meta.description: Connects the daslang MCP server so the agent can lint .das files, compile them with the engine's binding modules, syntax-check C++ translation units against the CMake compile database, and search daslang/C++ code by AST. The compiler-backed compile_check and list_* tools cannot simulate engine scripts (the LLVM emitter is not loaded in the server), so compile .das through tools/agent/das-check.sh instead. Turn the bundle off to remove all of its tools.
